mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_skill (tenant_id, agent_version_id, skill_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{skillId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_skill WHERE agent_version_id = #{agentVersionId} AND skill_id = #{skillId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_skill sk JOIN agent_version av ON sk.agent_version_id = av.id JOIN agent a ON av.agent_id = a.id AND av.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE sk.skill_id = #{skillId} AND sk.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (av.id = a.online_version_id OR av.id = a.editing_version_id)
